Title: Supply Chain Business Intelligence Engineer
Description: Job Description At Ford, we made history, and now we work to transform the future of mobility for our customers, our communities, and our families. By joining us, you will build what matters and drive progress with heart, developing tangible innovations you will see on the road every day that help people move freely and pursue their dreams. Here, you can build more than vehicles; you will grow in ways that count, supported by a global family and a culture built on passion, capability, community, and trust. Why Join Ford of Mexico? Celebrating over 100 years of legacy in Mexico, we are more than just a business we are a vibrant, collaborative community of over 14,000 innovators shaping the global future of transportation. At Ford, we build what matters, grow where it counts, and drive progress with heart. Whether you are collaborating at our state-of-the-art Global Technology and Business Center (GTBC) or manufacturing iconic, award-winning vehicles in our world-class plants, you will find a culture evolving together, built on trust, passion, and shared purpose. Here, your work moves people forward, and your growth is personal. Join us, and let’s build what’s next together. In this position... In this role, you will serve as the vital link between our physical manufacturing operations and our advanced data ecosystems. By designing, optimizing, and governing robust data pipelines and semantic models, you will empower our supply chain and supplier quality teams with actionable, real-time insights. Your work will directly prevent operational bottlenecks, drive digital transformation through automation and AI, and build a unified "Single Source of Truth" that shapes the future of our global manufacturing efficiency. Responsibilities What you'll do... Design and optimize centralized semantic data models (using tools like Power BI or Tableau) to establish a unified "Single Source of Truth" for critical supply chain and manufacturing metrics. Develop and automate robust ETL/ELT data pipelines using SQL and Python to streamline data integration from plant systems (such as manufacturing and enterprise resource planning systems) into business intelligence platforms. Collaborate with supplier quality and technical support teams to analyze manufacturing constraints, perform data-driven root-cause analyses, and track capacity planning and product launch milestones. Partner with business operations and strategy teams to translate complex technical engineering data into clear, high-level reporting that supports resource allocation, budget tracking, and strategic planning. Identify and implement automation and artificial intelligence (AI) solutions (such as Generative AI, Microsoft Copilot, or custom Python scripts) to optimize daily workflows, reporting efficiency, and technical documentation. Establish and maintain data governance frameworks, designing scalable star/snowflake schemas to ensure data integrity, security, and long-term operational continuity. Qualifications You'll have... Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechatronics, Robotics, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering (with a data focus), or a related field—or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree in a technology-related field is highly valued. Experience: 2 to 3 years of experience in Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or Business Intelligence roles within industrial, manufacturing, or supply chain environments. Demonstrated experience implementing or supporting AI/automation projects is preferred. Languages: Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to communicate technical insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Required Technical Stack: Data Analysis & BI: Advanced proficiency in data modeling, DAX, and Power Query (Power BI and/or Tableau). Data Engineering: Advanced SQL (query optimization, complex JOINs, UPSERTs) and Python (Pandas, ETL automation scripting). Modeling & Governance: Strong experience designing Star/Snowflake schemas and applying data governance principles. Even better, you may have... Modern Data Stack: Experience with tools like dbt, Snowflake, or Azure Databricks. Industrial/Operational Systems: Familiarity with SCADA, MES, IoT protocols (e.g., MQTT, Modbus), or systems like Ignition. Software Development: Basic knowledge of C#, ASP.NET, or API development. Ford of Mexico is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is essential to our success. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, or disability status. Our focus is to build the best team. If you think you can bring value to Ford, love to collaborate, prioritize and aim to deliver excellence in everything you do, we encourage you to apply! We thank all candidates for their interest, but only those selected for an interview will be contacted. #FordMexico

Description: Back to jobs New AI-Native Engineer, New Grad (Ingeniero/a de Software AI-Native — Inicio de Carrera) - Mexico City (Hybrid) Cidade do México / CMX / México Ready to accelerate your career? Clara is the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We've built the leading solution for companies to make and manage all their payments. We already help over 20,000 large and growing businesses operate with agility and financial clarity through locally issued corporate cards, bill pay, financing, and a powerful B2B platform built for scale. Clara is backed by some of the most successful investors in the world, including top regional VCs like monashees, Kaszek, and Canary, and leading global funds like Notable Capital, Coatue, DST Global Partners, ICONIQ Growth, General Catalyst, Citi Ventures, SV Angel, Citius, Endeavor Catalyst, and Goldman Sachs - in addition to dozens of angel investors and local family offices. We’re building the financial infrastructure that powers high-performing organizations across the region. We invite you to join us if you want to be part of a fast-paced environment that will accelerate your career and support you to do some of the best work of your life alongside a passionate and committed team distributed across the Americas. Ready to start your career at full speed? What you’ll actually do Ship production code in your first weeks — real features, real customers, real money moving. Own features end to end: design, build, test, deploy, watch the metrics, fix what you broke. Use AI across your workflow — coding, debugging, testing, research, automating the boring parts — and push the frontier of how your team uses it, not just how you do. Work directly with Product, Design, and senior engineers. Ask the dumb question early; it’s cheaper than the wrong build. Learn the domain deeply. B2B fintech in LatAm is genuinely hard — multiple countries, multiple regulators, real consequences. That’s what makes it interesting. Two tracks — tell us which one fits you Product Engineering (fullstack, backend-leaning) Backend services, APIs, and the interfaces on top of them. Our stack leans Java/Spring Boot, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, and AWS — but we don’t expect you to have used all of it. We expect you to have gone deep on something and to pick up the rest fast. Data & ML Engineering Pipelines, models, and the systems that make them useful in production — risk scoring, fraud signals, spend intelligence. Python, SQL, and modern data tooling. Applied and in production, not just notebooks. Who you are You’re at the start of your software career. Whether you finished your degree last month or took a different route to get here, this role is scoped for engineers without prior full-time software experience — and we’ll treat you accordingly. A technical foundation. CS, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics or similar — or equivalent ability you can demonstrate in code. You’ve built things, and you can point at them. A GitHub, a deployed app, a repo people actually use, a hackathon win, a contribution to open source, a bot that solved a real problem for real users. One thing you built and can defend in depth beats a list of ten you touched. You’re AI-native and you can prove it. Not “I’ve used ChatGPT.” We mean: you’ve built with AI — agents, RAG, evals, fine-tunes, a tool that automates something you were sick of doing — and you use AI tools every day in how you code. Come ready to show us the artifact and walk us through the decisions. Strong fundamentals. Data structures, algorithms, systems thinking. Competitive programming (ICPC, OMI, Codeforces), a strong thesis, or serious research all count and we want to hear about them. English proficiency. English is our corporate language — you’ll read, write, and discuss technical work in it daily. Ownership. You surface problems before they become blockers, you push things over the finish line, and you don’t wait to be told what to do. This is the single trait we screen hardest for. Nice to haves Basic proficiency in Portuguese or a desire to learn it. Why join Clara At Clara, you’ll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America. Who We Are We’re the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America. Certified as one of the world's fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work, and a LinkedIn Top Startup. Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive. Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive. Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar. Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment. What We Believe In #Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively. #Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters. #Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told. #Pride. We build products and experiences we’re proud of. #Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action. #Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission. What We Offer Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language) Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results If you’re ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America. Clara’s Hybrid Policy Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team. We don't enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you're expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp-up or when required by your leader. Structure both structured (engagement, business) and unstructured (survey/qualitative) data to be agent-queryable — usable by AI layers to reason directly over content quality, learner sentiment, and business outcome questions, not just populate a static dashboard. Own the logic and definitions that connect learner identity data to business/sales records, content completions to sales opportunities, and survey responses to the specific content they reference Lead the platform strategy for dashboards and models — keeping pace with Salesforce's evolving analytics and approved AI tooling — and lead the build of the underlying semantic model as our platform evolves. Comfort applying data science methods (cohort/propensity matching, predictive modeling, causal inference) to answer "does this actually work" questions, not just descriptive reporting. Advanced SQL experience querying large-scale cloud data warehouses (e.g. Snowflake), including learner activity data and sales/CRM data (opportunities, order line items, contracts). Experience structuring and analyzing unstructured/qualitative data — open-text survey responses, sentiment/theme extraction — turning free text into reportable, comparable signal. Working knowledge of cohort/propensity-matching methodology for business impact analysis. Expert Tableau dashboard-building, with strong data visualization and design sense; hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) to build, query, and maintain dashboards and models. Executive-ready storytelling across content performance, learner sentiment, and commercial impact narratives. Advanced English Preferred Qualifications Experience with Salesforce Agentforce, AI-driven analytics, or NLP/text-analytics workflows. Python for cohort modeling or qualitative theme extraction. Direct experience with Trailhead Tableau Certified (Desktop Specialist or Certified Data Analyst). Familiarity with agentic or AI-native BI tooling (e.g. Hex) or notebook-based visualization (e.g. Python + Plotly/Streamlit) as complements to Tableau. Openness to adopting new dashboard and BI tooling as it emerges.
